company.name: mdhub
company.shortDescription: mdhub is the operating system and AI workforce for behavioral health, automating care and operations.
company.description: mdhub is the operating system (EHR & CRM) and AI workforce for behavioral health, enabling providers to automate documentation, patient engagement, intake, scheduling, billing, and care coordination. By combining AI agents with clinical workflows, mdhub helps organizations reduce administrative burden, improve outcomes, and scale access to mental health care.
